validity.researcher_notes: IDENTITY FIRST (the orchestrator's question - which named TETCO project is this row?). This row is the MIDDLESEX EXTENSION PROJECT, FERC docket CP20-30-000, certificated by order 173 FERC para 61,072 on 15 October 2020: 1.55 mi of 20-inch pipe off Texas Eastern's existing 36-inch Line 20, a new metering and regulating station, and 0.20 mi of 16-inch interconnecting piping to Transco's Mainline E and Woodbridge Lateral, all inside Metuchen Borough and Edison Township, Middlesex County, New Jersey, delivering up to 264,000 Dth/d to CPV Shore Holdings' 725 MW Woodbridge Energy Center. Every recorded spec on the row matches that project exactly (1.75 mi = 1.55 + 0.20; '16, 20' in; 264 MMcf/d; ~$52-53M; NJ->NJ), so the identification is certain, not inferred. It is NOT confusable with any of the five sibling TETCO segment rows in scope: P0235 is Ohio Pipeline Energy Network (OPEN, Ohio, 76 mi), P0260 is TEAM 2014 (Uniontown PA -> NJ, 34 mi), P0261 is TEAL, the Texas Eastern Appalachian Lease (Ohio, 5 mi), P5832 is TEAM 2012 (PA/WV, 17.3 mi) and P5835 is TEAM 2021 (PA, 1 mi) - different dockets, states, scopes and years. The only near-miss on size is P5835 (1 mi, 30-inch, 18 MMcf/d in Pennsylvania), which is a different diameter, a different state and a 15x smaller capacity. NO duplicate, NO existence doubt, NO misclassification: the project is documented end to end in FERC's public docket and in 22 consecutive EIA releases. NAME DEFECT: the sheet's SegmentName is 'Middlesex EXPANSION Project'. FERC's docket, order, EA and all four Federal Register notices call it the 'Middlesex EXTENSION Project', and Enbridge's own (now 404) project page was /projects/middlesex-extension-project. EIA propagates the same 'Expansion' error, which is very likely where GEM took it from. SegmentName is not a worklist unit and is NOT staged in `contested` here so as not to displace the two staged values, but it should be corrected to 'Middlesex Extension Project'. SPEC DEFECT (the staged finding): StartYear1=2022 is wrong by a year. Texas Eastern's in-service compliance filing in RP21-1021-000 took effect 9/15/2021 (86 FR 45718, filed 8/6/21) and EIA has carried Completed Date 2021-09-28 / Year In Service 2021 in all 17 releases since October 2021. StartMonth1=9 is right; only the year is wrong. CONSEQUENTIAL DEFECT: with the true in-service month equal to the September 2021 date Texas Eastern proposed in December 2019 and FERC restated in the May 2020 EA, the project was never delayed - so Delayed='yes' and DelayType='inferred' are artifacts of the wrong StartYear1 and should both be CLEARED, together with the Delay [ref] cell so no orphan ref is left behind. That clearing is a recommendation, not a fill, so it lives here as contested values rather than in fills[] (the Delay unit is staged UNRESOLVED). OTHER CELLS ALL CONFIRMED - see fills[]: status, fuel, pipeline type, capacity, length, diameter, cost, location, operator and owner each now carry two independent verified refs. Caveat on the harvested citation pool: all 23 gem.wiki citations for this row belong to the shared TETCO SYSTEM page and NOT ONE of them names the Middlesex project; I opened or tested them all, and the one the sheet leaned on for this row's data is EIA's https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php navigation page (23 backlinks), which states nothing about any pipeline and is not citable. That is why every ref staged here is newly found rather than re-verified.
